comment: POSTGAME.md 12, P4e, the bottom of the Stair. Down past D. 212 to Map 78: lit, no encounters, the arrival once. Something Unscheduled met (trope once), 'Not today' and seen up to the Door. Back down: 'You came back!', fought and won - the switch, the card, the ride up. The schedule's 'Anticipated.'. A rematch, 'Again?', no second card. A loss: the porch. Pell: not a member, the card waits; a member, stamped on Form Z, both cards swapped, switch 223, and the not-provisional page with the roster amendment. The board's third card. The account's two lines.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; window._mark = () => { window._lines = []; window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); }; window._mark(); window._has = s => window._lines.some(l => l.includes(s)); window._dt = () => $gameVariables.value(2) - window._tropes;
window._auto = false; const t = Window_Message.prototype.isTriggered; Window_Message.prototype.isTriggered = function () { return window._auto || t.call(this); };

steps.comment: after the ending; Pell has explained Form A-1, but the party is not a member yet

steps.check: [$gameMap.mapId(), $gamePlayer.x, $gamePlayer.y, window._has('The dark stops all at once'), window._has('Visitors! Come in, come in!'), $gameMap.event(2).findProperPageIndex()]
steps.label: down past D. 212: one more flight, the dark stops, and somebody has seen you

steps.check: [$dataMap.note, $gameMap.encounterList().length, SceneManager._scene._spriteset._lamplight.visible]
steps.label: lit, no encounters, still continuance

steps.check: [$gameMap.event(3).event().name, $gameMap.event(3).findProperPageIndex()]
steps.label: it is in the middle of the room

steps.check: [$gameMap.mapId(), $gamePlayer.x, $gamePlayer.y, window._has("I'm not on anything. I asked."), window._has('Item six.'), window._has("Nobody's obliged."), window._has('something waves'), $gameSelfSwitches.value([78, 3, 'A']), $gameSwitches.value(222), window._dt()]
steps.label: the meeting (trope); not today; it sees you up, under the Door

steps.check: [$gameMap.event(2).findProperPageIndex(), $gameMap.event(3).findProperPageIndex(), $gameMessage.isBusy()]
steps.label: back down: no second arrival, and it remembers you

steps.check: [$gameTroop.troop().id, $gameTroop.members()[0].mhp, BattleManager.canEscape(), BattleManager.canLose(), window._has('You came back!'), window._dt()]
steps.label: you came back; the fight is Something Unscheduled; no escape, can lose

steps.check: [$gameMap.mapId(), $gamePlayer.x, $gamePlayer.y, $gameSwitches.value(222), $gameParty.numItems($dataItems[77]), window._has("That was the best afternoon I've ever had."), window._has('Nobody made you.'), window._has("You point out that it said it wasn't on anything."), window._has('So I did it myself.'), window._has("I didn't know where you'd get one."), window._dt()]
steps.label: won: thank you, the card it wrote on itself, and up

steps.check: [$gameMap.event($gameMap.eventIdXy(18, 1)).findProperPageIndex(), window._has('NOT ANTICIPATED.'), window._has("'Anticipated.'"), window._has('in your own hand'), window._has('All present and correct. - D.')]
steps.label: the schedule: 'Anticipated.' chalked beside item six

steps.check: [$gameTroop.troop().id, window._has('Again?')]
steps.label: a rematch: 'Again?'

steps.check: [$gameMap.mapId(), $gameParty.numItems($dataItems[77]), window._has('Nobody made you that time either.'), window._has('BOUNTY'), window._dt()]
steps.label: won again: thanked, no second card, and up

steps.until: $gameMap.mapId() === 34 && window._has('You come back in through the porch.') && !$gameMap.isEventRunning() && !$gameMessage.isBusy()

steps.check: [SceneManager._scene.constructor.name, $gamePlayer.x, $gamePlayer.y, $gameParty.members().every(a => a.hp === a.mhp), window._has("I don't get the practice."), $gameSwitches.value(222)]
steps.label: lost: sorry, and the porch, restored

steps.check: $gameMap.event(2).findProperPageIndex()
steps.label: Pell, not a member, card in hand

steps.check: [window._has('You are not a member.'), $gameParty.numItems($dataItems[77]), $gameSwitches.value(223)]
steps.label: a bounty is claimed by a member: the card waits

steps.comment: registered, provisionally, as guild.json does it

steps.check: $gameMap.event(2).findProperPageIndex()
steps.label: a member with the card: the stamping page

steps.check: [$gameParty.numItems($dataItems[77]), $gameParty.numItems($dataItems[78]), $gameParty.numItems($dataItems[27]), $gameParty.numItems($dataItems[79]), $gameSwitches.value(223), window._has('Form Z. Matters Not Anticipated.'), window._has('There is no form for this.'), window._has('not provisional.'), window._dt()]
steps.label: Pell stamps it DISCHARGED on Form Z; the Guild Card, not provisional

steps.check: $gameMap.event(2).findProperPageIndex()
steps.label: and after it, a member not provisionally

steps.check: [window._has('Registered. Not provisionally.'), window._has('Form C-12(S)')]
steps.label: with the roster amendment still offered

steps.check: $gameMap.event(3).findProperPageIndex()
steps.label: the board has a page for three cards

steps.check: [window._has('Three cards. There are usually two.'), window._has('Lives at the bottom of the Stair.'), window._has('Witnessed. Form Z.'), $gameVariables.value(5)]
steps.label: three cards; the third is its bounty, discharged; VAR_BOUNTIES untouched

steps.check: [window._has('Something Unscheduled was met at the bottom of the'), window._has('Stair, and fought, because nobody had to.'), window._has('Its bounty was discharged on Form Z.')]
steps.label: the account: met, fought, and discharged
